BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced the purchase of 713,946 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities, with the highest price paid per share being 885.4000 and the lowest at 872.8000, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 878.6170 per share. These shares were bought from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026, and all acquired shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 11 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 11 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 713,946 Highest price paid per share: 885.4000 Lowest price paid per share: 872.8000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 878.6170 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
